title: The Paper Ep 2: The Five W’s

sentences.en: I'm Jenna Fisher.
And I'm Angela Kinsey.
We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And we're best friends.
And now we're doing the ultimate Office Lovers podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专为你打造了终极《办公室》粉丝播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will dive deeper into the world of The Office with exclusive interviews,
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会通过独家采访深入探索《办公室》的世界，

sentences.en: behind-the-scenes details, and lots of BFF stories.
sentences.zh: 分享幕后细节，还有许多我们闺蜜之间的故事。

sentences.en: We're the Office Lady 6.0.
Happy New Year.
Happy 2026.
2026, lady.
We have a New Year's resolution.
We do.
Should we share it?
Yes, this is a shared BFF, not only just in our work life, but in our home life,
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个共同的闺蜜愿望，不仅是在工作中，在生活中也是，

sentences.en: shared New Year's resolution.
I've never had a shared New Year's resolution before.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未有过共同的新年愿望。

sentences.en: Me either.
I highly recommend it because I feel like we're going to hold each other accountable.
sentences.zh: 我强烈推荐这样做，因为我觉得我们会互相监督。

sentences.en: I do too.
Okay, say what it is.
It's called get off the hamster wheel.
That's right.
Because we work from home, and I've talked to a lot of people who manage businesses from home,
sentences.zh: 因为我们是在家办公，我和许多在家经营生意的人聊过，

sentences.en: you can very easily always be working or always be doing a chore.
sentences.zh: 你很容易就会一直处于工作状态，或者总是在做家务。

sentences.en: Or it's like, oh, I'm just going to throw this laundry in before I get on this Zoom.
sentences.zh: 或者就像是，哦，在开这个Zoom会议前，我先把这堆衣服洗了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
Or it's Saturday, so I'm just going to bang out a couple hours of work here in the morning.
sentences.zh: 或者今天是周六，我早上就顺便处理几个小时的工作吧。

sentences.en: But what happens is, you were saying, Ange, it's like, all of a sudden you wake up and
sentences.zh: 但正如你所说的，安吉，结果就是，突然有一天你醒来，

sentences.en: you're like, I have worked 20 days in a row without a full day off.
sentences.zh: 你会发现，我已经连续工作了20天，没有完整休息过一天。

sentences.en: Yeah, because you just like, you know, you just scooch little things in every day.
sentences.zh: 是啊，因为你就是，你知道，每天都会往里塞一点琐事。

sentences.en: But what you were saying, and I so agree, is that let's say you're like, oh, you know,
sentences.zh: 但正如你所说，我非常赞同，假设你说，哦，你知道，

sentences.en: it's Saturday morning.
I'm going to do a few hours of work.
sentences.zh: 我要做几个小时的工作。

sentences.en: But then it stays with you.
sentences.zh: 但那种工作状态会一直缠着你。

sentences.en: All day.
All day.
So then you're like, hmm, I wonder if Jenna saw that email.
sentences.zh: 然后你就会想，嗯，不知道珍娜有没有看到那封邮件。

sentences.en: And I'm like, no, no, no.
Turn that part of my brain off.
sentences.zh: 我要关掉大脑里的那部分开关。

sentences.en: Yeah.
So I am committed to you, Jenna, that we are going to take two days off every week.
sentences.zh: 所以我向你承诺，珍娜，我们每周都要休息两天。

sentences.en: Yes.
Weekends off.
Yes.
We're getting off the hamster wheel for a full decompress.
sentences.zh: 我们要跳出仓鼠轮，彻底放松一下。

sentences.en: And this was inspired by our break, where we took a full week off for our break.
sentences.zh: 这灵感来源于我们的假期，当时我们休了整整一周的假。

sentences.en: Yeah.
And we were like, oh, wow.
That felt good.
Feels good.
Yeah.
So we're getting off the wheel.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要从那个轮子上下来了。

sentences.en: And then I want to get us a gift that I was telling Jenna, and I'm sure you're going
sentences.zh: 然后我想给我们买个礼物，我之前跟珍娜提过，我肯定你会觉得，

sentences.en: to be like, I don't want it.
I want to get on a pillow or like some kind of embroidery, a little hamster on a wheel with
sentences.zh: 我想弄个枕头或者某种刺绣，上面绣着一只小仓鼠在轮子上，

sentences.en: a big X across it.
Why would I not want that?
I want that.
I want it to be like a visual reminder, because it's easy to climb on that wheel.
sentences.zh: 我想让它成为一个视觉提醒，因为人很容易又爬回那个轮子上。

sentences.en: It is.
Right?
Yes.
Mm-hmm.
All right.
All right.
Shared New Year's resolution.
Well, listen, we are excited to be back.
sentences.zh: 听着，我们很高兴能回来。

sentences.en: We're excited to be breaking down all of the episodes of the paper in the new year.
sentences.zh: 我们很高兴能在新的一年里解析《办公室》的所有剧集。

sentences.en: But we have a new, what would you call it?
sentences.zh: 但我们有个新的，该怎么说呢？

sentences.en: More new things.
We have a new format.
sentences.zh: 我们有了一个新的形式。

sentences.en: Oh, yes.
For the new year.
We are going to kick off each episode with a chit-chat suggestion from one of you.
sentences.zh: 我们每一集都会以你们其中一位提供的闲聊建议作为开场。

sentences.en: Yeah, we are having so much fun.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我们玩得太开心了。

sentences.en: You guys have sent us really great topics.
sentences.zh: 你们发给我们的主题真的很棒。

sentences.en: So let's kick off this episode with a suggestion from Stephanie A.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们用来自斯蒂芬妮·A的建议来开启这一集吧，

sentences.en: in San Diego, California.
sentences.zh: 她来自加利福尼亚州圣迭戈。

sentences.en: Hi, office ladies.
This is Stephanie in San Diego, California, originally from Ohio.
sentences.zh: 我是来自加州圣迭戈的斯蒂芬妮，老家在俄亥俄州。

sentences.en: Go Buckeyes.
My question for you is, where is the worst place you have been stuck for a long time?
sentences.zh: 我想问你们，你们去过最糟糕、被困了很久的地方是哪里？

sentences.en: Looking forward to hearing the answers.
I knew mine right away.
sentences.zh: 我一下子就想到我的答案了。

sentences.en: Same.
Go.
You go.
Me go?
Yeah, you go.
Mine's kind of long.
Mine's also long.
Oh, no.
Well, these are clearly core memories for us.
sentences.zh: 看来这些都是我们刻骨铭心的记忆。

sentences.en: Stephanie, great question.
Many, many, many years ago, when I was still married to James, we received a Christmas gift.
sentences.zh: 很多很多年前，我还在和詹姆斯结婚的时候，我们收到了一份圣诞礼物。

sentences.en: Okay.
And it was to go on an outing on a shark boat.
Oh, my gosh.
What's a shark boat?
You get on a boat.
Uh-huh.
Somewhere in, like, the Long Beach Harbor.
sentences.zh: 大概是在长滩港的某个地方。

sentences.en: Okay.
And you go out to sea, and then you see sharks, I guess.
sentences.zh: 然后你出海，我想你应该能看到鲨鱼。

sentences.en: Like they swim up by the boat.
sentences.zh: 就像它们会游到船边一样。

sentences.en: I think you go down in a cage.
sentences.zh: 我想你是要下到笼子里去。

sentences.en: And then you can see sharks.
sentences.zh: 然后你就能看到鲨鱼了。

sentences.en: Jenna.
Let me tell you what happened, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，让我告诉你发生了什么。

sentences.en: We loaded onto the boat.
Okay.
With enthusiasm.
And we got out.
Oh, we were 10 minutes on this boat.
sentences.zh: 噢，我们在船上待了十分钟。

sentences.en: I got so, so seasick.
sentences.zh: 我就晕船晕得非常非常厉害。

sentences.en: Like, so seasick that I spent the whole trip inside the little galley of the boat.
sentences.zh: 晕到什么程度呢，我整个行程都待在船上的小厨房里。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
Curled up under the dining table, there was no Dramamine.
sentences.zh: 蜷缩在餐桌底下，当时没有晕船药。

sentences.en: There were no options.
It was just me and my personal grit.
sentences.zh: 只有我和我个人的毅力。

sentences.en: And—
Just muscling through it.
That is a miserable feeling, that kind of nausea, that rocking back and forth.
sentences.zh: 那种恶心感，那种来回摇晃的感觉，真是太痛苦了。

sentences.en: Yes.
Because when you get out there, they stop the boat.
sentences.zh: 因为当你到了那里，他们会停船。

sentences.en: Yeah.
And so you're just rocking.
sentences.zh: 所以你就只能在那儿晃着。

sentences.en: Bobbing.
For hours.
Hours.
And my kids know about the shark boat experience.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子们都知道“鲨鱼船”的经历。

sentences.en: Because I have said, like, as an anecdote, if I can survive the shark boat, I can survive anything.
sentences.zh: 因为我曾把这当成一个轶事来说，如果我能熬过鲨鱼船，我就能熬过任何事。

sentences.en: And when I was getting chemo and I said that I didn't feel good, my kids said, is it worse than the shark boat?
sentences.zh: 当我做化疗时，我说我感觉不好，我的孩子们就问，有鲨鱼船那么糟糕吗？

sentences.en: Oh.
Like, that's how, like—
Right.
—how awful the shark boat was.
And I texted James about it.
sentences.zh: 我给詹姆斯发了短信说了这件事。

sentences.en: I said, do you mind if I tell the shark boat story?
sentences.zh: 我说，你不介意我讲鲨鱼船的故事吧？

sentences.en: And also, I can't remember.
Did you enjoy the shark boat?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢那次鲨鱼船之旅吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
Did he go in the cage?
He—no, he didn't.
He wrote me and he said, and he said I could quote him.
sentences.zh: 他写信给我，他说，而且他说我可以引用他的话。

sentences.en: He said, quote, it was one of the worst days of my life.
sentences.zh: 他说，引用原话，那是我人生中最糟糕的日子之一。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
He said I was miserable.
I didn't throw up like nearly everyone else around me.
sentences.zh: 我没有像周围几乎所有人那样吐出来。

sentences.en: And then I asked him about the cage.
sentences.zh: 然后我问了他关于笼子的事。

sentences.en: I said, did you see any sharks?
I wouldn't know.
I spent the whole trip under the table.
sentences.zh: 我整趟行程都躲在桌子底下。

sentences.en: He said they brought out a shark that was about nine inches long, and I pet it, and I felt terrible for it.
sentences.zh: 他说他们带出了一条大约九英寸长的鲨鱼，我摸了摸它，觉得它好可怜。

sentences.en: That's the only f***ing shark we saw.
sentences.zh: 那是我们看到的唯一一条该死的鲨鱼。

sentences.en: Worst day of my life.
sentences.zh: 我人生中最糟糕的一天。

sentences.en: Oh, that's Josh's worst nightmare.
sentences.zh: 哦，那是乔什最可怕的噩梦。

sentences.en: He gets so motion sick.
He can't go on a boat.
I have swam with sharks.
sentences.zh: 我倒是和鲨鱼一起游过泳。

sentences.en: You know that, though.
Yes.
Yeah.
But they weren't like big, scary sharks, and they were well-fed.
sentences.zh: 但它们不是那种又大又吓人的鲨鱼，而且它们都被喂饱了。

sentences.en: And Rashida and I swam with them.
sentences.zh: 拉什达和我跟它们一起游过。

sentences.en: I mean, it sounds like the only shark that James saw was about the size of a large fish.
sentences.zh: 我是说，听起来詹姆斯看到的唯一一条鲨鱼也就大鱼那么大。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
Nine inches?
I mean—
That's—and you guys, it was all day on that boat.
sentences.zh: 那是——而且你们知道吗，在那条船上待了一整天。

sentences.en: All day.
That's horrible.
Yeah.
Oh.
Yeah.
I got through it by telling myself that time passes.
sentences.zh: 我靠告诉自己时间会流逝才熬过来的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
Time can't stop.
This day will end.
The sun will move through the sky.
Night will come.
The boat will dock, and I will get off.
That was the mantra I played in my head.
sentences.zh: 这就是我在脑海中不断重复的咒语。

sentences.en: It was my own personal, the edge.
sentences.zh: 那是我个人的，边缘时刻。

sentences.en: I was just going to say, you're like singing Annie.
sentences.zh: 我正想说，你就像在唱《安妮》一样。

sentences.en: The sun will come out tomorrow.
Basically.
Oh, my gosh.
All right, that's the worst place I've ever been stuck.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那是我被困过最糟糕的地方。

sentences.en: What about you?
Well, Jenna, I actually was texting you from the worst place I've ever been stuck.
sentences.zh: 嗯，珍娜，其实我当时就在我被困过最糟糕的地方给你发短信。

sentences.en: So I'm going to jog your memory now.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在要帮你回忆一下。

sentences.en: Was it—
Well.
It was the biggest snowstorm in North Texas in 21 years.
sentences.zh: 那是北德克萨斯21年来最大的一场暴风雪。

sentences.en: It was December 24th, Christmas Eve, 2009.
It's actually called the Christmas Eve blizzard.
sentences.zh: 它实际上被称为平安夜暴风雪。

sentences.en: And I was flying back to see my family for the holidays with Isabel the morning of Christmas Eve.
sentences.zh: 平安夜那天早上，我正带着伊莎贝尔飞回去看望家人过节。

sentences.en: I think, Jenna, that year we worked right up into the holidays.
sentences.zh: 我想，珍娜，那一年我们一直工作到假期开始前夕。

sentences.en: So that was the day I could get out of town.
sentences.zh: 那天我终于可以离开那个小镇了。

sentences.en: And my dad said, well, there's a big storm coming in.
sentences.zh: 我爸说，有一场大风暴要来了。

sentences.en: So get the early flight.
Get the earliest flight.
sentences.zh: 一定要赶最早的那一班。

sentences.en: Because once you land in Dallas, our family farm is a good two-and-a-half-hour drive from Dallas.
sentences.zh: 因为一旦在达拉斯落地，我们家的农场距离达拉斯还有两个半小时的车程。

sentences.en: So we're talking rural farm-to-market roads.
sentences.zh: 那可都是些乡间的农贸公路。

sentences.en: And, you know, they don't go out and treat those roads.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们根本不会去清理那些路。

sentences.en: They don't put salt on them.
They ice over.
So my dad was like, we are going to need to get on the road.
sentences.zh: 所以我爸就说，我们得赶紧上路。

sentences.en: Okay.
So we land.
Temperatures drop to, like, their 20s.
sentences.zh: 气温降到了华氏20多度（约零下几度）。

sentences.en: Winds kick up to, like, 60 miles an hour.
sentences.zh: 风速飙升到了每小时60英里。

sentences.en: It's snowing like crazy when we land.
sentences.zh: 我们落地时雪下得特别大。

sentences.en: They close DFW Airport.
sentences.zh: 达拉斯-沃斯堡国际机场关闭了。

sentences.en: Oh, I remember all this now.
Yeah.
No more flights going out.
So we get in the car.
And as we start to drive, it is just coming down and coming down.
sentences.zh: 刚开始开车，雪就一直下个不停。

sentences.en: Isabel was only 19 months old.
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝尔当时才19个月大。

sentences.en: It was me, my mom, my dad, Isabel, and Warren.
sentences.zh: 车里有我、我妈、我爸、伊莎贝尔，还有沃伦。

sentences.en: And it was like a whiteout.
sentences.zh: 外面简直是一片白茫茫。

sentences.en: My dad could barely see.
sentences.zh: 我爸几乎什么都看不见。

sentences.en: We were watching cars slide off the road into snowdrifts.
sentences.zh: 我们眼睁睁看着车子滑出路面，掉进雪堆里。

sentences.en: I remember this.
Hundreds of people were stranded in this storm.
sentences.zh: 成百上千的人都被困在了这场风暴中。

sentences.en: And, you know, these little towns did not have the resources to get this many people stranded out of the snow.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这些小镇根本没有足够的资源去救助这么多被困在雪里的人。

sentences.en: So they called out to, like, local farmers.
sentences.zh: 所以他们向当地的农民求助。

sentences.en: They were getting their tractors, their plows, trying to get people out.
sentences.zh: 农民们开着拖拉机和犁地机，试图把人们救出来。

sentences.en: I ran out of everything in our diaper bag.
sentences.zh: 我尿布包里的东西全用光了。

sentences.en: We ran out of food.
We were stuck.
And we made it as far as outside of this town called Decatur.
sentences.zh: 我们好不容易才开到迪凯特镇外。

sentences.en: And we were at the bottom of this hill.
sentences.zh: 当时我们正处在一个山坡下。

sentences.en: And when you got to the other side, the farmers had been kind of successful clearing the road a little bit on the other side.
sentences.zh: 山坡的另一边，农民们已经成功清理出了一小段路。

sentences.en: But no one could get over the hill.
And it was just like all of these cars slid off in the snow.
sentences.zh: 所有的车都滑进了雪里。

sentences.en: And then you'd watch another one try.
sentences.zh: 然后你就会看着下一辆车试图冲坡。

sentences.en: And my dad sat there.
We were running out of gas.
And he would turn the car off to save the gas.
sentences.zh: 为了省油，他会把车熄火。

sentences.en: And we'd get really cold.
sentences.zh: 然后我们就会觉得特别冷。

sentences.en: We would be able to see our breath.
And then he'd turn the car on for a little bit.
sentences.zh: 过一会儿他会把车发动起来。

sentences.en: We'd warm up.
And we were doing this, like, intermittently.
sentences.zh: 我们就这样断断续续地撑着。

sentences.en: And just sitting there watching car after car try this hill and go into the snowbank.
sentences.zh: 坐在车里看着一辆又一辆车尝试冲坡，然后滑进雪堆里。

sentences.en: Now it's nightfall.
Our windshield has frozen over.
sentences.zh: 我们的挡风玻璃结冰了。

sentences.en: And I'm getting really worried because I have a 19-month-old.
sentences.zh: 我真的很担心，因为我带着一个19个月大的孩子。

sentences.en: And I'm just like, it's cold.
We're running out of gas.
And my dad was like, we got to go for it.
sentences.zh: 我爸说，我们必须得冲过去。

sentences.en: We got to go for the hill.
We just have to.
And we had no—my dad—oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 我们当时没有——我爸——天哪。

sentences.en: My dad felt so bad because we never get this kind of weather there.
sentences.zh: 我爸感到非常愧疚，因为我们那儿从没遇到过这种天气。

sentences.en: He didn't have an ice scraper for the windshield.
So he got out his country music CDs and busted them apart so they'd get sharp and jagged.
sentences.zh: 于是他拿出乡村音乐CD，把它们掰碎，弄出尖锐的锯齿状边缘。

sentences.en: And they got out there, him and Warren, like, scraping off the ice on the windshield.
sentences.zh: 他和沃伦就出去，用那玩意儿刮挡风玻璃上的冰。

sentences.en: My dad slipped and fell.
I was like, oh, my gosh, Dad, are you okay?
sentences.zh: 我当时心想，天哪，爸，你没事吧？

sentences.en: And I'll never forget, my dad goes, I'm all right, but my dignity took a hit because he wiped out.
sentences.zh: 我永远忘不了，我爸说，我没事，但我的尊严受损了，因为他摔得太惨了。

sentences.en: Okay, I have to tell you, that's when I start texting you.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我得告诉你，那就是我开始给你发短信的时候。

sentences.en: I was like, Jenna, I'm worried.
sentences.zh: 我当时说，珍娜，我很担心。

sentences.en: I'm worried.
It is dark.
People are stranded in their cars.
And you said, Ange, I'm scared.
I mean, as you're retelling this story, I am having all those feelings come back.
sentences.zh: 我是说，当你重述这个故事时，我所有的感觉又回来了。

sentences.en: And also, this is like—this is not a funny story.
sentences.zh: 而且，这根本不是什么有趣的故事。

sentences.en: This is like a traumatic story.
sentences.zh: 这简直是个创伤性的故事。

sentences.en: No, it's not.
I'm sorry.
But it's the—
It's the truth.
It is the worst place I've ever been stuck.
sentences.zh: 那是我被困过最糟糕的地方。
